metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a fly and somehow scared off that 1 unlucky soul? Valorant logic again
metadata.description:
Tapping like I forgot what aiming means
That 1 poor enemy probably rebooting life
Did NOT deserve that accidental chaos but hey, free kill vibes
Click if your aim’s mostly happy accidents too!

Tap if your aim’s mostly ‘wait what just happened?’ moments!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
